description: Tutorial T3 wagon_turn on touch: tap the Battlewagon row, Advance, Confirm Movement Mode, Keep Roll and drag the hull by touch; then grab the hull (touch + small slide), KEEP holding, and tap the toolbar rotate button twice with a SECOND finger -> the held wagon turns 30 degrees without the gesture turning into a pan/pinch; lifting drops it and the step completes.

steps.script:
TouchInputAdapter.set_enabled(true)
return TouchInputAdapter.enabled

TutorialManager.start_lesson('t3_get_movin')
return true
return TouchInputAdapter.inject_tap_text('Advance')
return TouchInputAdapter.inject_tap_text('Confirm Movement Mode')
return TutorialManager.current_step_id() == 'keep_da_roll'
return TouchInputAdapter.inject_tap_text('Keep Roll')
return TutorialManager.current_step_id() == 'wagon_move'

var mp = GameState.get_unit('U_BATTLEWAGON_T').models[0].position
var p = tree.current_scene.get_node('BoardRoot').get_global_transform_with_canvas() * Vector2(mp.x, mp.y)
TouchInputAdapter.set_meta('w', p)
TouchInputAdapter.inject_touch(0, TouchInputAdapter.get_meta('w'), true)
return true

TouchInputAdapter.inject_touch(0, TouchInputAdapter.get_meta('w') + Vector2(0, 24), false)
return true

var mp = GameState.get_unit('U_BATTLEWAGON_T').models[0].position
var p = tree.current_scene.get_node('BoardRoot').get_global_transform_with_canvas() * Vector2(mp.x, mp.y)
TouchInputAdapter.set_meta('w', p)
TouchInputAdapter.inject_touch(0, TouchInputAdapter.get_meta('w'), true)
return true

var mc = tree.current_scene.movement_controller
return mc.dragging_model and TouchInputAdapter.state == 2

var mc = tree.current_scene.movement_controller
return mc.dragging_model and TouchInputAdapter.stats.toolbar_second_finger == 2 and abs(float(mc.selected_model.get('rotation', 0.0)) - PI / 6.0) < 0.01

TouchInputAdapter.inject_touch(0, TouchInputAdapter.get_meta('w') + Vector2(20, 0), false)
return true
return TutorialManager.current_step_id() == 'wagon_confirm' and abs(float(GameState.get_unit('U_BATTLEWAGON_T').models[0].get('rotation', 0.0))) > 0.4
